faq.q: Can a first-time buyer avoid property transfer tax on a townhome on this page?
faq.a: On price alone, in the lower part of the band: the first time home buyers' program exempts a qualifying purchaser on the first $500,000 of the purchase price, its full exemption requires a fair market value of $835,000 or less and a partial exemption may apply to $860,000 — townhomes above $860,000 are outside it on price, though the program's other conditions still have to be met either way.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Surrey freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Surrey?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Surrey?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
